    • subscribe

      public NostrSubscription subscribe(Collection<NostrFilter> filter)
      Creates a subscription based on the provided filters.

      This method creates a subscription that will match events against the given filters, using the default event tracker class for duplicate detection.

      Parameters:
      filter - A collection of filters that define what events to receive
      Returns:
      A new subscription instance

    • subscribe

      public NostrSubscription subscribe(NostrFilter filter, Supplier<EventTracker> eventTracker)
      Creates a subscription using the specified filter and event tracker.

      This method allows specifying both the filter for matching events and a custom event tracker implementation for handling duplicate events.

      Parameters:
      filter - The filter defining what events to receive
      eventTracker - The event tracker class to use for this subscription
      Returns:
      A new subscription instance

    • fetch

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<List<SignedNostrEvent>> fetch(NostrFilter filter, int numEvents, @Nullable Duration timeout)
      Fetch up to numEvents events matching the given filter until timeout is reached or numEvents have been received.

      The method might return less events if the timeout is reached before numEvents

      Parameters:
      filter - The filter to match events against
      numEvents - The number of events to fetch
      timeout - The maximum duration to wait for events, null means no timeout
      Returns:
      A promise that resolves with up to numEvents matching events or when the timeout is reached

    • fetch

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<List<SignedNostrEvent>> fetch(NostrFilter filter, int numEvents, boolean withEose, @Nullable Duration timeout)
      Fetch up to maxEvents events matching the given filter until timeout is reached, numEvents have been received or all relays have sent EOSE if withEose is true.

      The method might return less events if the timeout is reached before numEvents or if all relays have sent EOSE and withEose is true

      Parameters:
      filter - The filter to match events against
      numEvents - The number of events to fetch
      withEose - If true the fetch will end when all relays have sent EOSE even if neither numEvents nor timeout are reached
      timeout - The maximum duration to wait for events, null means no timeout
      Returns:
      A promise that resolves with up to numEvents matching events or when the timeout is reached

    • fetch

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<List<SignedNostrEvent>> fetch(Collection<NostrFilter> filters, NostrPoolFetchPolicy fetchPolicy)
      Fetch events matching the given filters using the specified fetch policy.
      Parameters:
      filters - The filters to match events against
      fetchPolicy - The fetch policy to determine when to stop fetching events
      Returns:
      A promise that resolves with the list of matching events based on the fetch policy

    • fetch

      public org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<List<SignedNostrEvent>> fetch(Collection<NostrFilter> filters, Supplier<EventTracker> eventTracker, NostrPoolFetchPolicy fetchPolicy)
      Fetch events matching the given filters using the specified event tracker and fetch policy.
      Parameters:
      filters - The filters to match events against
      eventTracker - A supplier that provides an event tracker instance for handling duplicates
      fetchPolicy - The fetch policy to determine when to stop fetching events
      Returns:
      A promise that resolves with the list of matching events based on the fetch policy

    • close

      @Deprecated public List<NostrRelay> close()
      Deprecated.
      This method does not disconnect relay transports by design to support shared relays. This is deprecated because the name was misleading use clean() to both unsubscribe and remove relays or removeAllRelays() to just remove relays without unsubscribing or unsubscribeAll() to just unsubscribe without removing relays.
